title: rhobound-mcp shared definitions
description: The shared definitions of ARCHITECTURE.md 5.4 (Handle to Refusal), then the ones the other schemas of this folder add. Every object is closed (additionalProperties: false) unless its description says otherwise.

Handle.description: server-minted ULID, bound to the caller's principal, expires

Route.description: a route template, only from http.route or rpc.method, optionally after the method and one space; never from url.path

Code.description: a finding or refusal code from the registry: domain.name

Env.description: an environment name from server configuration, never a bucket, prefix or path

ChangeItem.description: a number the caller supplies; always labelled declared. v1 applies own_ms, own_pct, workers and load_scale; the others are refused with change.unsupported_op until the variance patch (cs2) and the structural patch ship

MeasuredRef.description: a reference to a record the server verified; the server copies the numbers and mints the label

examples.description: trace ids, span ids or object keys that show the defect

Trigger.description: what raises a code, and so which test covers it (DATA.md 17)

Digest.description: a content id: sha256 of canonical bytes

Sha256Hex.description: a bare sha256, as files are listed

Float.description: a float64 that may be non-finite; JSON has no NaN or infinity, so they are written as these strings

Label.description: where a number came from (ARCHITECTURE.md 4.3); only the CLI or the server mints a label other than declared

KeptShare.description: the share of requests the capture holds and how it was obtained (DATA.md 3.8)

version.description: the build's version (-X main.Version): 1 to 64 letters, digits and . _ + ~ -, the first a letter or a digit; fit and diff-fit refuse to run under another

Tool.description: the tool that computed a record; content ids include GOARCH because the last bits of floating point differ between architectures (ARCHITECTURE.md 4.1)

Scope.description: the short scope code every result carries (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.9)

RuleToken.description: a gate rule token (ARCHITECTURE.md 5.4, 6.3), a namespace separate from codes; it may cite the finding code that triggered it, as input_refused:<code> (rule 1) and, in this draft, doubt_holds:<code> (rule 5)

ServerLinks.description: server: resource links; never printed by a CLI twin
